messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty fired PD-83412 for capacity/queue backlog on inference-prod. queue_len=1800+, sustained 6m. Affected: inference-prod, batch-ingest, realtime-router. https://pagerduty.example/PD-83412
pagerduty: [AUTO] PD-83412 — severity=P1; runbook=/runbooks/autoscale-backlog.md; responders=@eng-oncall
oncall-jay: acked. grabbing logs & current cluster state now. tagging infra-lee.
sara: seeing a lot of pods Pending with "FailedScheduling: 0/0 nodes available: Insufficient gpu." also ~30 pods with ImagePullBackOff on sidecar-proxy (registry rate-limit).
miguel: autoscaler verbatim: "ScaleUp: desiredDelta=10 reason=queue_backlog" then cloud: "quota_exceeded: GPUs requested 10, available 0" then autoscaler: "suppress scale up (cooldown window)". plus cluster maxNodes=120 already hit.
oncall-jay: quick steps: 1) manual burst node-pool +6 (temp) 2) relax cooldown to 20s for burst pool 3) enable degraded routing for non-SLA customers to quantized models 4) CS notify. executing now.
ops-bot: executing nodepool resize... command run: 
```
gcloud container node-pools update np-burst-infer --cluster=prod-cluster --num-nodes=66
```
ops-bot: Launched 6 nodes np-burst-infer-230..235. nodes registered, kubelet joined.
emily: customer-impact: error-rate on /v1/generate up +6% in eu-west-1; tail p95 latency rose to ~3.2s, some timed-out requests. CS alerted; posting on status page.
sara: initiated temporary image pull workaround: bumped pull throughput by switching to authenticated mirror for sidecar image for affected nodes. also draining and restarting 12 sidecar pods.
miguel: opened cloud ticket CLD-21190 asking for quota bump +30 GPUs, flagged as emergency. submitted phone escalation. ticket: https://cloud.example/tickets/CLD-21190
oncall-jay: also spotted that some nodes are preemptible/spot and were recently reclaimed, contributing to capacity churn. switching burst pool to on-demand for now. command: 
```
kubectl patch nodepool np-burst-infer -p '{"spec":{"instanceType":"on-demand"}}'
```
ops-bot: patched nodepool, new nodes provisioning as on-demand.
oncall-jay: enabled routing fallback: for tenant tags non-sla:* route -> model-lite-q4; critical tenants remain on full model. increased worker drain concurrency (--max-drainers=4) to speed processing.
emily: CS update ready: short note posted on status: "Weare experiencing elevated latencies in EU; mitigation in progress; some requests may degrade to lighter model. ETA 30-45m." pinging priority customers.
infrastructure-lee: noted cluster maxNodes limit in config. proposal: temp bump cluster maxNodes to 200 and then revert after incident. i'll stand by to approve emergency override.
miguel: autoscaler metrics: queue length started to drop after manual nodes joined, but still >500. keeping watch.
oncall-jay: timeline/actions for handoff: 1) keep burst nodes up for 2h, 2) monitor PD alert and queue every 5m, 3) follow CLD ticket for quota, 4) if queue stalls >30m escalate to infra lead for emergency override, 5) night-oncall-anna takes watch in 1.5h. leaving kube commands and logs in incident doc. :clipboard:
night-oncall-anna: acknowledged handoff, will monitor and reach infra-lee if needed overnight.
cs-sam: CS: notified 4 affected customers directly; offering status updates and workaround (route to non-SLA fallback).
pagerduty: PD-83412 acknowledged by oncall-jay; escalation halted. please update incident timeline and mark mitigations.
oncall-jay: leaving runbook note: do not scale down burst nodes until queue < 50 for 20m and Cloud quota confirmed. handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: summary: manual on-demand capacity added, fallback routing enabled for non-critical tenants, queue draining underway, customer impact limited to elevated latencies in EU. CLD ticket opened for quota increase. continue monitoring in thread for postmortem details.
